rubric_interpretation: The same development criteria apply unchanged. Semantic relevance and syntax are separate. A clear and modest response can acknowledge a feeling implicitly; unsupported topic changes, ignored requests and contradictions fail. Borderline h02a is recorded separately as partial and conservatively excluded from fully appropriate answers; no post-holdout tuning is permitted.
